raw.title: Product Analyst
raw.description:
London/Hybrid

£40,000 - £60,000 + share options up to £14,500 + Benefits

💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

The team

We have a massive vision and even more ideas, but right now, our ambitions are outstripping our capacity. That’s where you come in. We aren't looking for someone to just "run the reports" we’re looking for a foundational member of a growing function who is excited to help us redefine how data influences product.

At Accurx, we don't just wait for a roadmap to be handed down; we expect everyone to help shape it. While you'll be part of a team of expert data and product leaders, you'll be the one in the driver's seat for your domain. You won't be watching from the sidelines - you'll be proactively hunting for insights, challenging our current assumptions, and taking ownership of how data can save clinician time from day one. This is a role for a critical thinker who is energised by the "blank canvas" of a growing function and has the drive to turn raw data into a better reality for millions of patients.

Challenges you’ll solve...

  • You will steer product strategy by partnering with Product Managers to define what success looks like and by monitoring the KPIs that prove our impact on the frontline of healthcare.

  • You will interrogate user behaviour by performing deep-dive analyses that look past the surface to find the "why," ensuring we’re solving the right problems for the right people.

  • You will lead rigorous experiments by helping design and run A/B tests, owning the process from the initial hypothesis through to the final, data-backed recommendation.

  • You will build the engine for self-service insights by creating the dashboards and visualisations that ensure your pod has high-quality data at their fingertips to move fast.


You should apply if...

  • You've worked within a product team environment (not just as a standalone data or BI function), partnering directly with Product Managers, Engineers, and Designers on live product decisions, not just reporting on outcomes after the fact.

  • You are a proactive investigator who doesn't need a ticket to start digging; when things are quiet, you’re already looking for the next trend or bottleneck that we’ve missed.

  • You have a "get stuck in" mindset - you’re excited by a lean environment where you can build your own processes and take on challenges that push you outside your comfort zone.

  • You bring strong Product Thinking with an understanding of user funnels and a hunger to master metrics like activation, retention, and cohort behaviour.

  • You are sharpening a strong technical toolkit, with a solid command of SQL and the ambition to use Python.

  • You are a delivery-focused collaborator who thrives in agile environments and knows how to communicate technical findings clearly to engineers and designers.

  • You’ve used tools like Mixpanel or Amplitude and are ready to become a power user who empowers the whole team through effective data storytelling.

What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

  • £40,000 - £60,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

  • Equity: £14,500 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

  • Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

Compensation: £40K – £60K • Offers Equity

  • • £40K – £60K • Offers Equity

raw.title: Chief of Staff, CFO
raw.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team:

Finance & Corporate Development helps Airwallex grow with control. We’re a trusted partner to the business, providing actionable insights on performance, supporting market and product expansion and helping to shape the future of our product. We ensure that Airwallex meets its financial reporting, tax and safeguarding obligations globally. We work with existing and prospective investors to raise capital and ensure it is deployed effectively.

This is a team for people who want to reimagine how the office of the CFO works. We’re looking for founder-like energy, high integrity and a passion for technology. You’ll thrive here if you enjoy working cross-functionally, think from first principles and can balance speed of execution with analytical precision.

What you’ll do:

As Chief of Staff to our Group CFO, you’ll be the CFO’s right hand across three divisions: Finance & Corporate Development, People & Talent, and global Operations. You will run the operating rhythm that keeps those teams aligned, own the CFO’s most important projects from first framing to delivery, and help build a CFO-led programme that brings Airwallex closer to the finance leaders we serve.

You’ll work directly with the CFO, the CEO, the executive team and our investors.

This role is based in our London office.

Responsibilities:

  • Run the CFO’s operating cadences: Ensure the smooth running of the Finance, People & Talent and Operations divisions, driving divisional OKRs, business reviews, leadership team meetings and offsites.

  • Own strategic projects end to end: lead the CFO’s highest-priority cross-divisional projects, from problem definition to delivered outcome. Examples could include org changes, M&A integration, process redefinition and analytical work.

  • Shape executive and Board communication: Support the CFO in the creation of internal and external-facing materials, including Board, Exec and Investor materials.

  • Build the CFO go-to-market programme: partner with GTM to run CFO-hosted events, roundtables and a community for finance leaders, and track the commercial impact.

Who you are:

Minimum qualifications:

  • Proven experience, with a foundation in top-tier strategy consulting, private equity or investment banking and preferably some in-house experience in a fast-growth environment

  • Strong financial acumen: you build models, read a P&L and balance sheet fluently, and frame decisions in unit economics and return on investment.

  • A track record of leading complex, cross-functional programmes to completion

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior experience as Chief of Staff to a C-Suite executive

  • Experience in payments, cross-border or another regulated financial services business.

  • Experience with M&A/corporate finance (including fundraising)

  • Experience building executive events or communities.

  • An entrepreneurial streak: you’ve founded a business or side project.

You’ll thrive here if:

  • You can connect the dots across teams and functions

  • You keep asking why until you feel like you really understand something

  • You don’t wait for permission to fix things that you know are broken

  • You are willing to be disagreeable when you need to be

  • You can build consensus to get things done

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

How you'll make impact

You’ll help businesses bring financial services directly into their own products, using Airwallex’s embedded finance infrastructure to support their customers across markets. You’ll own complex, consultative sales cycles from prospecting and discovery through commercial negotiation, contract signature and launch.

  • Build relationships with vertical SaaS companies, marketplaces, fintechs and other platforms.

  • Help customers embed accounts, payments, payouts, FX and cards into their products.

  • Understand each customer’s business model, platform architecture and money flows, then shape a clear commercial proposition.

  • Navigate technical integrations, onboarding, compliance requirements and multi-stakeholder buying processes.

  • Build pipeline across the UK/I enterprise market through account research, outbound prospecting, referrals, industry networks and targeted engagement.

  • Work closely with SDRs, Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Risk, Operations and Account Management to develop business cases, run technical workshops and support a strong handover into implementation.

  • Contribute to the embedded finance sales playbook by sharing customer insight, competitive context and deal learnings.

You’ll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • Five years of sales experience, ideally in complex B2B, enterprise or technical sales.

  • Experience owning consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and technical or API-enabled products.

  • Strong discovery, commercial negotiation, presentation and deal-orchestration skills.

  • The ability to understand a customer’s business model, platform architecture and money flows, then translate complex requirements into a clear commercial proposition.

  • A track record of building pipeline, progressing opportunities and closing deals through ambiguity and long sales cycles.

  • The confidence to engage stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Customer Success.

Preferred

  • Payments experience in fintech, particularly with embedded finance, platforms, marketplaces, acquiring, payouts or issuing.

  • Experience selling to platform customers such as vertical SaaS companies, fintechs or marketplaces.

  • Experience selling APIs, financial infrastructure, banking-as-a-service, payment infrastructure or other technical products.

  • Around five or more years of experience in enterprise or strategic sales.

  • Experience navigating longer, technical sales cycles with multiple decision-makers and implementation dependencies.

You'll thrive here if

  • You have a track record of hitting your numbersYou're excited by a category that hasn't been won yet, and want to be early enough to shape it.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.

Learn more about your team

Our Enterprise team helps large, often multinational organisations solve complex financial challenges. We’ve segmented the team by the problems they solve with our customers - moving money globally and managing treasury operations internally with our Spend solution, and embedding financial services across borders to expand their product offering for their customers with our Platform solution. This role will focus on the latter, helping customers understand what is possible with third-party embedded financial services, but will work closely with other roles who focus on first-party financial operations.

It’s a team for strategic sellers with a builder mindset, who combine strategic, value-driven thinking with deep product knowledge. We are comfortable with long deal cycles, multiple stakeholders, and ambiguity in processes. We are autonomous in our approach, taking ownership of our day to day approach and success, while working collaboratively within the team for best practices. We represent ourselves and the team with integrity and thoughtfulness, working cross-functionally in a respectful and cooperative manner. If you want to work on technically complex high-consequence deals that genuinely impact how customers go to market, this is the place to do it.

raw.title: Human Resources Administrator
raw.description:
About Us
At algo1, we are reinventing one of the world’s most familiar experiences: the in-store grocery trip. We are building an AI-native product that understands each shopper, responds to their context in real time and makes an everyday experience less stressful, more personal and more engaging.

We’re backed by leading investors and founded by two entrepreneurs: one with a track record of building companies, and the other a leader in retail data and shopper analytics. Together, they have brought together frontier AI researchers and engineers, product and strategy leaders, and senior operators from major UK and US grocery businesses.

The people who join now will have an opportunity to shape the product, the engineering culture, and what algo1 becomes.

The Role
This role reports to our Chief of Staff and works closely with our leadership team and hiring managers across the business. It is part-time and currently set at two days per week (0.4FTE).

You’ll keep our people operations running smoothly as we grow, from the moment a candidate accepts an offer to the everyday policies, systems and reporting that help our team do their best work. You’ll make sure the details are right, the paperwork is compliant, and every new joiner gets a great first impression of algo1.

What You’ll Own

  • Support our hiring process. Coordinate the admin behind every hire, keeping candidates and hiring managers informed and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between offer and first day.

  • Manage right to work and visas. Carry out right to work checks, manage visa and sponsorship processes, and keep accurate, compliant records.

  • Prepare offers and contracts. Customise offer letters and employment contracts for each new hire, and manage the signing process through DocuSign.

  • Maintain people policies and processes. Keep our policies and processes up to date, and communicate them clearly so everyone knows how things work and where to find them.

  • Run our people systems. Look after our people systems and the data within them, keeping records accurate and processes efficient.

  • Building a great place to work. Contribute ideas and energy to the culture, engagement and employee experience initiatives that make algo1 a great place to work.

  • Support the Chief of Staff. Take on a variety of projects for our Chief of Staff, from operational improvements to one-off initiatives across the business.

About You

Must Have

  • People operations experience. Experience in an HR / people operations or recruitment coordination role, ideally in a fast-growing business.

  • Attention to detail. A meticulous approach to contracts, records and data, with the discretion to handle sensitive information confidentially.

  • Systems confidence. Comfort working with HR systems, e-signature tools like DocuSign, and spreadsheets to keep data accurate and produce reports.

  • Clear communication. The ability to write and explain policies and processes in a way that is friendly, clear and easy to follow.

  • Flexibility. We are a start-up. Being comfortable with ambiguity and the need to adapt is important.

Nice to Have

  • UK employment compliance. Working knowledge of UK right to work checks and experience supporting visa and sponsorship processes.

  • Sponsor licence knowledge. Familiarity with managing a UK Skilled Worker sponsor licence and its reporting duties.

  • HR qualification e.g.CIPD.

  • AI and automation curiosity. An interest in using AI tools to streamline admin and improve people processes.

How We Work
This is a fast-paced environment. The people who thrive here are curious, proactive, and organised. If you’re happiest when you’re making things run better, you’ll fit right in.

We draw our energy from being together, so this is a part-time, office-based role. It suits someone who enjoys the quick conversations and shared momentum that comes from working together. Our office is on what we think is the best garden square in London, just a couple of minutes from Tottenham Court Road, so it’s easy to get to and a great place to be.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (pro rata)

  • 25 days’ annual leave (pro rata).

  • A part-time role with a working pattern agreed together.

  • Real ownership from day one.

  • The chance to help shape the culture of a fast-growing AI company.

About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Allica exists for the half a million or so established SMEs with typically 5 to 100 employees. These SMEs are a crucial pillar of the UK’s prosperity - representing more than a quarter of all turnover and jobs - yet are increasingly neglected by traditional high street banks.

Since early 2021 Allica Bank has been building its direct SME relationship proposition too. Our vision is to reimagine Local Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people and digital tools.

Our Central Relationship Managers (Central RMs) will initially be focussed on assisting SMEs with turnover up to £1m supporting clients business ambitions through the provision of day-to-day banking facilities including business current accounts and savings as well as commercial mortgages and asset finance. Over time, we’re building a wider SME banking product to offer working capital solutions, and you’ll represent Allica across all these products too.

Role Description

Supporting a portfolio of centrally managed customers, ensuring they are well served with strong customer satisfaction, ensuring good credit risk management of your portfolio and growing the portfolio via your own business development activities and working with Allica’s marketing team and their lead generation capabilities.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Successfully relationship managing a centralised portfolio of local SMEs, providing secured SME lending including commercial mortgages and asset finance, alongside current accounts and savings, widening over time in line with our offering.

  • Through ongoing proactive client engagement and forward-looking conversations to unlock opportunities to support businesses with their plans and ambitions.

  • Credit risk monitoring for your portfolio including spotting early warning signs and fulfilling additional credit requests.

  • Originating SME lending opportunities from initial enquiry through to completion, including writing credit papers in line with Allica’s credit policy and appetite.

  • Delivering the business plan for your portfolio, and actively managing your objectives and personal development plans. Capable of horizon risk scanning, interpreting local markets and delivering action plans.

  • You’ll be able to evidence an ability to work expertly with customers, colleagues and advisors to structure new lending proposals and write credit applications.

  • Making your colleagues proud that you represent Allica, by ensuring excellent service for SME customers, prospects and advisors. You are a trusted partner for customers, building deep, multi-layered relationships.

  • Working closely and collaboratively with all areas of Allica to ensure a seamless and professional service is always provided.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • A deep passion for serving SMEs.

  • Self-starter organised and committed to succeeding in a flexible environment.

  • Highly capable relationship manager, with a track record of building high-value, trust based and long-lasting referral relationships, and the ability to develop good levels of new business on the back of these.

  • Good credit skills, including the ability to analyse and review financial accounts and associated information.

  • You will need to have a strong understanding of SME banking, which must include a strong background in commercial mortgages.

  • You will be able to demonstrate a history of exemplary level of service, and of maximising the value with prospects and customers.

  • You will have excellent interpersonal and communication skills together with evidence of strong career progression and/or outperformance.

  • You’ll be able to evidence an ability to work expertly with customers, colleagues and advisors to structure new lending proposals and write credit applications.

  • You’ll have a proven track record in providing excellent customer service, and in generating new income opportunities whilst effectively managing credit risk.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

raw.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Growth is a critical function at Allica, sitting at the intersection of marketing, product, sales, and data. Our team is responsible for driving sustainable and scalable customer acquisition, engagement, and retention—ensuring our banking solutions reach and resonate with the right SMEs at the right time. Growth is both a science and an art. We blend commercial strategy with deep customer understanding, leveraging data to uncover new opportunities while ensuring every touchpoint aligns with Allica’s mission to empower established SMEs with the banking they deserve.

Role Description

The Growth Manager will play a key role in driving effective and sustainable growth across Allica's BRA customer journey — from onboarding through account activation and into deeper, embedded product usage. This role focuses on understanding customer behaviour end-to-end, identifying where customers stall or disengage, and building the strategies and capabilities needed to move them forward.

Using a data-driven approach, the Growth Manager will lead the design and delivery of initiatives that improve activation, engagement, and long-term customer value — often working with limited precedent and translating diagnosis into tools, frameworks, and ways of working that the wider business relies on. They will build alignment across marketing, product, sales, RM, and data teams, ensuring growth strategy is coherently applied across the customer journey.

This role is ideal for someone with strong applied critical thinking, a track record of leading initiatives with real ambiguity, and the ability to build stakeholder alignment without formal authority over the teams they influence.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Customer Behaviour & Cohort Analysis: Lead analysis of customer behaviour, lifecycle stages, and cohorts to identify key drivers of activation, engagement, and product usage, delving into complex problems to reach root-cause understanding rather than surface patterns.

  • Data-Driven Insights & Strategic Recommendations: Own the growth and engagement metrics that matter most for the customer journey, translating insight into strategy that shapes how the team and wider business operate.

  • Experimentation & Optimisation: Manage a robust experimentation pipeline, designing, prioritising, and overseeing tests across initiatives to ensure impactful, evidence-based decisions rather than one-off analysis.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration & Alignment: Build alignment across departments; marketing, product, sales, RM, and data, managing differing stakeholder expectations to keep initiatives progressing.

  • Framework & Capability Building: Take diagnosed problems through to operational reality, building the tools, scoring frameworks, and processes that other teams adopt and rely on.

  • Leadership & Ownership: Manage multiple objectives concurrently, ensuring accountability for outcomes even where the path forward isn't well precedented.

  • Communication: Design and deliver insightful, visually compelling presentations that influence decision-making and align stakeholders on growth strategy

Personal attributes & Experience

  • Experience working in hypothesis-led, problem-solving environments (e.g. high-growth start-ups, consulting or similar) is a plus.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and navigate complex, ambiguous problems using structured thinking.

  • Proven experience conducting complex data and performance analysis, ideally using SQL to work with large datasets.

  • Comfortable working with technical systems and integrations (e.g. CRM, analytics tools, automation platforms) to improve efficiency and scale.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Options for flexible working

This is a high‑impact, high‑ownership role: you’ll combine sharp strategic thinking with hands‑on execution, bringing deep local market insight and broad channel expertise to acquire customers, improve conversion and accelerate revenue growth. raw.title: Account Executive – Strategic Retail, UK&I, Nordics
raw.description:
At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product-passionate community & enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever-expanding retail, social & search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands & retailers to gain valuable business insights from real-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.
 
The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long-term loyalty.
 
Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.
 
Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.
 
It’s official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!

Bazaarvoice is looking for an extraordinarily talented, high-performing Account Executive to join our EMEA sales team. This role is designed for a unique, new-business hunter who craves a challenge, thrives outside their comfort zone, and possesses the strategic rigor to manage a high-value retail territory across the UK.

As an Account Executive for Strategic Retail, you will build a pipeline and drive the sales cycle from start to finish. If you are a consultative storyteller who can navigate complex enterprise organizations, build consensus, and defend a high-ROI solution to C-level executives, we want to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Orchestrate the Territory Ecosystem: Act as the strategic leader of your territory. Conduct account planning, territory management, and continuous pipeline generation, while rallying internal cross-functional resources to maximize coverage and close deals.

  • End-to-End Deal Architecture: Manage the entire lifecycle of high-value enterprise SaaS deals—from initial prospecting and precise qualification to sophisticated contract negotiation and closure.

  • Strategic Opportunity Mapping: Move beyond standard discovery to conduct deep-dive analyses into a retailer's business model. Reveal latent pain points and align Bazaarvoice’s high-ROI solutions with their business objectives.

  • Value Defense & Executive Presence: Partner with a prospect’s marketing, merchandising, and technology staff. Confidently demonstrate and defend the ROI of our platform, successfully building consensus from Marketing Managers up to CMO, CTO, and Procurement levels.

  • High-Velocity Discipline & Forecasting: Drive urgency throughout the sales funnel, handle objections with resilience, and maintain a high volume of outbound activity. Deliver exceptional qualification and accurate forecasting over a two-quarter period.

  • Thought Leadership: Stay ahead of e-commerce industry trends, competitor movements, and shifts in consumer behavior to provide proactive strategic guidance.


    • What You'll Bring:

  • Proven Track Record: 3 year experience in a customer-facing, new-business SaaS hunter role, with a proven history of managing high-value portfolios and consistently exceeding quotas.

  • Retail & Digital Savvy: Strong knowledge of and experience selling into large, complex retail organizations.

  • Strategic & Financial Acumen: Expert in value-selling innovative software in a fast-changing space. Ability to articulate complex ROI models and use data-driven storytelling to win complex "consensus" buys.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead internal support teams, articulate a clear account strategy, and secure the internal resources needed to win.

  • The Bazaarvoice DNA: A high level of enthusiasm, coachability, and an unwavering work ethic. You are comfortable hearing "no," shaking it off, and pivoting your strategy to find the "yes."

  • Right to Work: Eligibility to work in the UK without restrictions.


    • Desirable Criteria:

  • Industry Background: 3+ years of experience selling e-commerce, MarTech, or digital marketing technology, with established relationships up to the CMO level.

  • Brand Experience: Experience selling to large consumer brands in addition to major retailers.

  • Global Mindset: Additional European language skills are a strong plus.


    • Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Net New Revenue: Driving net new business within the Retail segment.

  • Pipeline Velocity & Accuracy: Consistently generating pipeline and moving opportunities through the funnel with speed and precise forecasting.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Successfully leveraging and orchestrating your internal support resources to maximize territory efficiency and deal sizes.

    • Why join Bazaarvoice?
     
    Customer is key
    We see our own success through our customers’ outcomes.  
    We approach every situation with a customer first mindset.
     
    Transparency & Integrity Builds Trust
    We believe in the power of authentic feedback because it’s in our DNA. 
    We do the right thing when faced with hard choices. Transparency and trust accelerate our collective performance.
     
    Passionate Pursuit of Performance
    Our energy is contagious, because we hire for passion, drive & curiosity. 
    We love what we do, and because we’re laser focused on our mission.
     
    Innovation over Imitation
    We seek to innovate as we are not content with the status quo. 
    We embrace agility and experimentation as an advantage.
     
    Stronger Together
    We bring our whole selves to the mission and find value in diverse perspectives. 
    We champion what’s best for Bazaarvoice before individuals or teams.  
    As a stronger company we build a stronger community.
     
     
     
    Want to see our culture in action? Explore our global Linkedin Life Page, Life at Bazaarvoice to see the bigger picture, or visit our EMEA Life Page to meet our regional teams and see what life is like in our local offices.  
     
     
     
    Commitment to diversity and inclusion
     Bazaarvoice provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all team members and applicants according to their experience, talent, and qualifications for the job without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, disability, sex (including pregnancy, gender stereotyping, and marital status), sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, military/veteran status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law in every location in which the company has facilities. Bazaarvoice believes that diversity and an inclusive company culture are key drivers of creativity, innovation and performance. Furthermore, a diverse workforce and the maintenance of an atmosphere that welcomes versatile perspectives will enhance our ability to fulfill our vision of creating the world’s smartest network of consumers, brands, and retailers.
     
     
     
    Please note: Candidates who are successful will be required to undergo a Basic level DBS (Disclosure and Barring Service) background check.

raw.title: Full Cycle Technical Recruiter
raw.description:
Our Mission

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About Brain Co.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.

Why Now

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

 

About the Role

We’re looking for a Full Cycle Technical Recruiter to own end-to-end hiring for Brain Co.’s Engineering teams (AI/ML, AI Product, AI Platform). You’ll partner closely with our in-house recruiting team and engineering leadership to attract and close world-class technical talent — the kind of people who define the next decade of applied AI.

This isn’t a “req-filler” role. You’ll design and drive our recruiting engine — from crafting outbound strategies and refining our brand narrative to managing candidate experience and closing complex offers across global markets.

You’ll be joining a high-trust, high-velocity environment where recruiting is seen as a strategic advantage — and your work will directly shape the caliber and trajectory of Brain Co.’s technical team.

 

You’ll Own

  • Full-cycle recruiting across AI/ML, AI Product, and AI Platform roles — from sourcing to offer close

  • Partnering with leadership to define hiring needs and interview processes

  • Driving candidate experience that reflects our speed, precision, and mission-driven culture

  • Building market maps and data-driven sourcing strategies across competitive AI talent pools

  • Negotiating complex offers and compensation packages in collaboration with execs and finance

  • Serving as an ambassador for Brain Co.’s brand at events, conferences, and online communities

 

You Might Thrive in This Role If You:

  • Have 3–6+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience (agency or in-house, early stage experience)

  • Must have experience with engineering or technical roles

  • Have successfully hired AI/ML Engineers, Product Engineers, or Platform/Infra Engineers

  • Are a strong storyteller who can translate technical work into a compelling narrative for candidates

  • Are metrics-driven and know how to build pipelines that convert

  • Excel in high-autonomy, fast-moving environments where recruiting = impact

  • See recruiting as both art and strategy — relationship-driven, data-informed, and deeply collaborative

  • Believe in Brain Co.’s mission to bring applied AI into the real world

     

Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Paid Maternity and Paternity Leave

  • Daily Lunches + Dinners

  • Commuter Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced and commercially minded Senior HR Business Partner to join our People & Culture team and partner closely with senior leaders across EMEA.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for an HR professional who thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments and enjoys operating at both a strategic and operational level. You’ll play a key role in translating business priorities into people strategies that enable growth, strengthen organisational culture and deliver measurable business outcomes.

With teams across the UK, Portugal and Brazil, you’ll bring a strong understanding of working across different cultures and markets, while helping the organisation navigate transformation and change.

You’ll have the opportunity to influence leadership decisions, shape organisational design, develop talent and succession pipelines, strengthen performance management, and lead initiatives that enhance the overall employee experience.

What You’ll Do

Partner with Senior Leadership

  • Act as a trusted strategic partner to senior leaders across EMEA, providing insight and challenge on people, organisational structure, performance and workforce matters.

  • Translate business strategy and evolving priorities into practical People & Culture solutions.

  • Support leaders in making informed, people-focused decisions in a fast-moving environment.

Drive People Strategy & Transformation

  • Develop and deliver People & Culture initiatives that directly support business objectives and deliver measurable impact.

  • Lead and contribute to organisational transformation and change initiatives across the region.

  • Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, policies and ways of working, ensuring they remain agile and fit for purpose.

Lead Core HR Processes

  • Own and support end-to-end workforce planning and headcount management.

  • Drive succession planning and talent development pipelines.

  • Lead performance management cycles, including calibration and development planning.

  • Support employee engagement, culture and organisational effectiveness initiatives.

Use Data to Drive Decisions

  • Leverage people analytics and HR metrics to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.

  • Turn data and insights into clear recommendations for leaders.

  • Use evidence-based approaches to continuously improve people processes and employee experience across diverse teams.

Coach & Develop Leaders

  • Provide hands-on coaching to leaders on effective people management, feedback, performance, conflict resolution and leadership development.

  • Help leaders build high-performing, inclusive teams and foster a culture of open communication and continuous improvement.

Collaborate Across People & Culture

  • Work closely with Talent Acquisition, People Development, Compensation & Benefits and Culture teams.

  • Ensure HR policies, programmes and practices are aligned, consistent and responsive to the needs of the business and our people.

What We’re Looking For

You’ll bring:

  • Proven experience in an HR Business Partner, People Partner or strategic HR role, ideally within an organisation experiencing significant growth, transformation or change.

  • A strong track record of partnering with senior leaders in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

  • A hands-on approach, with the ability to move confidently between strategic thinking and operational delivery.

  • Strong experience across performance management, talent development, succession planning and organisational culture.

  • Excellent commercial and strategic thinking, with the ability to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people solutions.

  • Experience working across different countries, cultures and organisational contexts within EMEA.

  • A strong analytical mindset, with experience using people data, HR metrics and reporting to inform decisions and improve processes.

  • Exceptional communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.

  • The ability to build trusted relationships at all levels and confidently challenge and coach senior leaders.

  • A proven ability to operate effectively through ambiguity, change and evolving organisational priorities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working within a technology, startup or high-growth environment.

  • Experience leading organisational transformation or change management initiatives across multiple regions.

  • Knowledge of Portuguese would be an advantage.

 
Collaboration is our superpower, diversity unites us, and excellence is our standard. 
We value diverse identities and life experiences, fostering a diverse, inclusive, and safe work environment. We encourage applications from diverse and underrepresented groups to our job positions.

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this team?

Internal Infrastructure builds the infrastructure and tools used to train, evaluate, and serve Cohere's foundation models. You will work with AI researchers and ML engineers on stability, scalability, and observability. The work accelerates the models behind Cohere's platform, North.

You will own the developer platform researchers use to write, build, and debug training code: dev environments, container images, CI, and training instrumentation. The role includes a compensated 24x7 on-call rotation.

What you will do

  • Run secure developer environments that stay controlled and accelerate developer velocity as the research org scales.

  • Own container image build and CI/CD tooling.

  • Instrument training code and build self-service tooling so researchers can see why a run failed and debug it themselves.

  • Set infrastructure best practices through AI enablement, documentation, and office hours.

  • Troubleshoot production failures and performance problems, and leave the system easier to operate than you found it.

  • Build automation, infrastructure-as-code, and observability so the platform stays maintainable.

We hire at more than one level. We set level based on the scope you've owned and how independently you drive work.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • Run a developer platform in production: CI, image builds, dev environments, or internal tooling that many engineers depend on.

  • Made ML engineers or researchers faster without making the platform fragile.

  • Enough Linux and Kubernetes to debug production systems. Experience operating a GPU cluster is a plus.

  • Written software in Python or Go. You would rather extend a solid open-source project than rebuild it.

  • Worked with researchers, ML engineers, or another team whose goals were not identical to yours.

  • Found a bottleneck, proposed a fix, and driven it in a fast-moving environment.

If this does not line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

Position Overview

As a GTM Associate, you’ll sit at the centre of Condukt’s commercial engine, generating new pipeline across financial services and working hand in hand with our Account Executives to turn it into revenue.

You’ll build opportunities from the ground up: reaching high-growth fintechs and financial institutions with well-researched outreach, qualifying inbound interest quickly, and running first discovery conversations. Your work doesn’t end at the first meeting. You’ll stay on the deal with our Account Executives, help build the customer relationship and, as you grow, lead smaller deals end to end alongside an AE.

As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move with urgency, and are excited to help build both a market-leading product and a repeatable enterprise sales motion. Assistant Financial Controller
raw.description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Reporting to Sarah Phillips, you’ll own month-end for Flock’s finance team and strengthen the controls around it, running the close and producing the variance analysis and MI that FP&A and our senior team use for budgeting and reporting. We’re automating finance on our new platform and the team uses AI every day, so there’s plenty of room to improve how the work gets done as well as doing it.

It suits a recently qualified accountant with strong core accounting from practice, who has already improved a process or control somewhere and wants to keep growing within the finance team.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the month-end close from start to finish so it lands accurately and on time.

  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and post journals, keeping the ledger clean and well evidenced.

  • Run variance analysis and build the monthly MI pack, explaining what moved and why.

  • Strengthen our financial controls and automate manual steps wherever you find them.

  • Prepare our VAT returns and assist with group reporting.

  • Work with FP&A so the numbers behind budgets and senior reporting are right.

  • Support the annual audit and work alongside our external auditors.

  • Use AI tools in your daily work to speed up reconciliations, analysis and reporting, and share what works with the team.

  • Pick up ad hoc finance projects, including R&D tax claims if you have the experience.

 

What you’ll need

  • An ACA qualification, ideally recently qualified, although we’ll also consider strong ACCA or CIMA candidates.

  • A practice background with hands-on month-end experience, whether from non-audit client work or time in industry. Big 4 or not makes no difference to us.

  • Solid core accounting and close attention to detail, including balance sheet reconciliations, journals and variance analysis.

  • Experience strengthening financial controls or improving a finance process, with an example you can talk us through.

  • Curiosity and ambition, with the drive to push things forward and keep learning.

  • An interest in AI. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should already be using it at work or in your own time and want to do more with it.

Nice to have:

  • Audit experience.

  • Experience using NetSuite.

  • Experience automating finance processes.

  • Exposure to R&D tax claims.

  • Experience in the tech sector.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

 

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. ESSENTIAL

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry.

  • Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. 

  • A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives.

  • An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm.

  • Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes.

  • Experience building networks of brokers in a Commercial Motor Fleet setting. 

  • Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market.

About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

More fleets are choosing Flock and our Customer Success team needs to grow. You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. You hear first hand what matters to customers and brokers, and your suggestions for improving how we work carry real weight. AI is part of the day job too, because Flock runs on it. You will use it to prepare for meetings, dig into fleet data and stay on top of your book. You do not need insurance experience. You need the service instincts that make clients want to deal with you, and the appetite to learn everything else.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Owning a portfolio of fleet customers end to end, from onboarding through to renewal, with clear accountability for keeping them

  • Handling inbound policy queries from customers and brokers by phone and email, resolving them quickly and helping people self-serve where that suits them better

  • Running quarterly reviews with fleet managers and brokers, then tracking the actions that come out of them, and supporting broker onboarding with the Distribution team

  • Delivering safety and claims interventions when our telematics data flags a risk, working with the Claims and Underwriting teams on triggers and follow-up

  • Working across Underwriting, Finance and Product to investigate and resolve the trickier issues, including policy referrals and connectivity troubleshooting with our telematics partners

  • Capturing customer feedback and raising process, automation and self-serve suggestions so our service keeps improving

  • Using Flock's AI tools every day to prepare customer insight packs, draft follow-ups and keep your book organised

 

What you'll need

  • A background in customer service, customer success or account management. The sector does not matter to us; the quality of your service does

  • Rapport that comes naturally. Our customers should genuinely like dealing with you

raw.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 2, that looks like this:

 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

raw.description:
About us

Infinite Lambda is a data and AI consultancy that helps the world’s leading companies become data-first. We design and build modern, cloud-native data platforms, and we help our clients turn them into real business value with AI.

We’re one of Europe’s fastest-growing consultancies, and we’re now a global team across three regions. Headquartered in London, we have engineers and consultants in the United States, the UK, France, Italy, Hungary, Slovakia, Romania, Bulgaria, Vietnam and Singapore. We’re also building new teams in Brazil, Argentina and Chile.

Our mission is to bring exceptional people together to make an impact where technology meets sustainable growth. You’ll work alongside experts in dbt, Snowflake and the wider modern data stack on complex, meaningful projects, in a culture built on curiosity, experimentation and continuous learning.

We’re a diverse team, and we want everyone to feel comfortable being themselves at work. If you want to grow fast, learn constantly and help shape where we go next, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role

Every enterprise wants to be AI-ready, and most are held back by legacy data estates built over decades. As Enterprise Migrations Practice Area Lead, you’ll own how Infinite Lambda solves that problem: moving the world’s largest organisations off Informatica, Talend, SSIS/SQL Server, DataStage, stored procedures and, increasingly, SAS and Alteryx, onto modern platforms ready for AI.

Enterprise migrations are a core pillar of our growth strategy, and this role sets the standard for how we deliver them globally. The practice spans the full migration lifecycle:

  • Assess: Estate discovery, feasibility analysis and migration strategy, ending in a fixed-cost, fixed-timeline proposal that gives clients certainty from day one.

  • Convert: Automated code conversion with Flowline, our proprietary product, which combines deterministic and LLM-assisted methods. This stage also covers refactoring, optimisation and a first-pass ontology that lays the foundation for AI use cases.

  • Validate: Reconciliation architecture and row-level sign-off, so every migration is provably correct.

The first part is delivery excellence that compounds. You’ll make sure every migration we deliver is better than the last. That means defining the standards, building the playbooks and reusable assets, and turning the lessons from each strategic engagement into capability across the practice. You’ll also develop the engineers and leads who carry that standard across AMER, EMEA and APAC.

The second part is commercial impact. You’ll turn delivery quality into a competitive edge: faster delivery, sharper scoping and pricing, and healthy margins you can measure and report on. Working closely with Sales and Solution Engineering, you’ll shape the offer that makes Infinite Lambda the obvious choice for enterprise migration, anywhere in the world.

Responsibilities

1. Practice and standards

  • Be the person engineers, sales and clients ask when a migration question is hard: what to migrate first, what to refactor and what to move as is, and how to resolve conflicting logic.

  • Own the migration standard for Assess, Convert and Validate. This covers reference architectures, sequencing, reconciliation and stage-gate checklists, and what we won’t do.

  • Make sure Fast and Deep Discovery produce a defensible estimate, a dependency map and early red flags before we commit to a fixed price.

  • Hold the same quality bar in every region: conversion quality, reconciliation sign-off and post-go-live incidents.

  • Keep the practice up to date as Flowline, the source parsers and the target platforms change (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Iceberg).

2. Knowledge, IP and the asset catalogue

  • Join engagements at scoping and agree what each strategic migration should leave behind (patterns, decisions, failure modes, measurements) and who will capture it.

  • Capture lessons at wave checkpoints, and close each engagement with a review of what worked, what didn’t, and what should change in the standard.

  • Decide which lessons become reusable assets and which stay one-offs.

  • Bring field requirements and recurring challanges to the Flowline product team, and move proven assets into Product & Services.

3. People and enablement

  • Build a global bench of migration specialists. Develop engineers across AMER, EMEA and APAC into a team that can deliver migration waves to our standard, independently and at scale.

  • Own the path from practitioner to leader. Design and run the progression that takes engineers from dbt and Snowflake foundations, through Flowline accreditation and deep expertise in a legacy source system, to owning delivery waves and ultimately leading client assessments.

  • Turn what we know into how we work. Make our accelerators and existing assets visible and reusable across every team, so each engagement starts from our best work rather than a blank page.

4. Commercial

  • Make sure live engagements actually use the practice’s accelerators.

  • Help Sales and Sales Engineers scope, estimate and price from measured delivery speed, so the client pays for the acceleration instead of getting it for free.

  • Make the commercial case for the practice in proposals, extensions and new scope. This includes turning Discovery engagements into migrations and expanding into BI and semantic-layer work.

5. Partners and internal work

  • Act as the technical lead in joint pursuits with Snowflake, Databricks, dbt and Fivetran, and feed what we learn in delivery into joint go-to-market, certifications and co-marketing.

  • Write interview material and run technical interviews for migration roles.

  • Present the practice’s work inside the company and, where it makes sense, at external events and in case studies.

Requirements

  • Ownership at a strategic level. You take full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks. You’ve owned a practice, a service line or a major programme end to end (its direction, quality, people and commercial results), and you’re comfortable making the calls that shape how a business delivers.

  • Enterprise migration experience at scale. You have a track record of leading large, complex migrations off legacy platforms such as Informatica, Talend, Oracle, SSIS or DataStage, and you know where these programmes tend to go wrong.

  • Depth across both ends of the migration. You have hands-on knowledge of legacy source systems and modern platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Iceberg, dbt, Fivetran), plus a structured approach to assessment, conversion and validation.

  • A builder of repeatable delivery. You’ve defined reference architectures, sequencing frameworks and quality gates, and built libraries of reusable assets and accelerators that teams actually use.

  • A multiplier of talent. You’ve developed engineering teams across regions through mentoring, structured skill pathways and accreditation, and you’ve raised the bar for how those teams deliver.

  • Credibility with clients and partners. You can lead discovery sessions with senior client stakeholders, act as the technical lead in joint pursuits with partners such as Snowflake and Databricks, and assess engineering talent in interviews.

  • Commercial awareness. You understand how delivery choices affect scoping, pricing and margin, and you enjoy working with Sales to win the right work.

Line management & how you will be supported

Your line manager is the Chief Customer Success Officer, who is accountable for your direction, the practice charter and the review of your objectives. Strategic direction will be consulted with CTO and Head of Engineering.

Why join Infinite Lambda

  • We support your growth with dedicated learning time, access to top-notch resources and a knowledge-sharing culture;

  • You work autonomously here in a wholesome environment and get as much paid holiday as you need;

  • The projects are diverse and give you plenty of opportunity to experiment with new tech;

  • The benefits are plenty, with work-from-home budget, a company MacBook and more on the list.

Examples of said proof include extract n°3 of the Criminal Record (France), Büntetlen előélet (Hungary), Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check (UK), an extract from the Criminal Register (Slovakia), or a country-specific equivalent. Providing proof of a clean criminal record is the final step in the hiring process and will only be requested should the applicant accept an offer from Infinite Lambda.
