  • Minimum of 5 years related work experience; bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Consistent track record of meeting and exceeding lead generation and new account development objectives.
  • Fluent English and German or French preferred but not essential 
  • Excellent communication skills in writing, speaking, listening, and outbound calling - able to communicate clearly, concisely, and with precision.
  • Proficiency in our sales tech stack, or the ability to become proficient quickly: Salesforce (CRM, pipeline and reporting), Gong (email outreach and engagement tracking), Common Room (contact enrichment, prospecting and intent data) and Claude (research, account planning and outreach).
  • Stays current with AI and prospecting tools, and tests and applies them to improve outreach quality and efficiency.
  • Experience calling into Fortune 1000 accounts preferred.
  • Ability to understand and successfully promote technical offerings and solution sets, supported by strong curiosity about business problems and product value.
  • Highly motivated and positive, with an entrepreneurial, self-starting mindset and strong planning skills.
  • Demonstrated coachability - you seek feedback, apply it quickly, and continuously refine your approach.
  • Creative approach to outreach, with the ability to build sequences and test new messaging and cadences across email, phone and social channels.
  • Strong self-learning mindset: proactive in developing your sales craft through reading, testing, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong ownership mentality - takes responsibility for pipeline creation, follow-through, and results without outsourcing challenges.
  • Ability to prioritize work assignments and shift efforts based on business goals and team needs.
  • Strong working knowledge of Claude, including running account and contact research, creating and maintaining projects with reusable context, using and building Claude skills for repeatable workflows (research, call prep, sequence drafting), and checking outputs before they reach a prospect.
  • Ambitious about long-term career growth in sales, with a clear desire to progress into quota-carrying roles.
  • Must be able to travel as needed (For marketing / sales events and internal meetups in Europe and Sales Kick-Off in the U.S) 

    • THE BENEFITS
  • Fully remote based with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the UK
  • Flexible working hours
  • Working within a team of friendly, skilled people where help is always within reach
  • 25 vacation days per year in addition to public holidays
  • 4 recharge days, where the entire company goes on a brief pause in all geographies for 1 day each quarter. This day can be spent in whatever way helps you recharge, to regain energy, and dive back into the next workday
  • 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year
  • Group Life Insurance
  • Income Protection Insurance
  • Accident Insurance
  • Pension Salary Exchange Scheme
  • Optional Medical Insurance
  • Travel insurance for business travels
  • Cell phone allowance up to 80£ per month
  • High-end laptop (Windows or Mac)
  • Competitive pay and bonus/commission
    •  
    THE VENDAVO STORY 
    Vendavo partners with the world’s leading companies to accelerate growth and profitability, advance innovation, and build more prosperous communities. Our powerful, cloud-based, AI-powered pricing, selling, and prescribing solutions empower global manufacturers and distributors to manage, optimize, and digitize their end-to-end commercial processes. But we offer so much more than software. Our proven, repeatable process, and passionate, experienced people accelerate value and drive profitable, unrivaled business outcomes for our customers. We are passionate about helping our customers deliver the right products, at the right prices, at the right time, for the right people. 
     
    OUR SAAS PRODUCTS 
    Our B2B pricing and selling solutions include Vendavo’s Pricing & Strategy Management (Pricepoint, Enterprise Pricing Platform, Deal Price Optimizer, and Vendavo AI), Sales & Quoting Solutions (Intelligent CPQ and Sales Optimizer), Profit and Margin Analytics (Profit Analyzer and Margin Bridge Analyzer), and Incentive & Channel Operations (Rebate and Channel Manager).  You can learn more about our products here.
     
    OUR FUNDING
    We are backed by two of the top high-tech private equity firms in the world, have excellent financial health, and boast the top SaaS retention in our space.
     
    OUR CULTURE & YOU
    We collaborate with our customers unlike any others in our industry. Anchored in our values (Integrity, Customer Centricity, Innovation, Clarity, Collaboration), we are growing, constantly innovating, and consistently driving sustainable outcomes for our clients and partners.
     
    Unlocking opportunities for our customers would not be possible without our employees. When you are part of Vendavo, you’re part of a company that’s committed to your growth and invested in your career. Diversity, inclusion, and celebration of community are at our core, and we come together to learn from each other and honor our commitments.

Senior Casting Partner
raw.description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Casting Partner for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.


This is a Hybrid role working from our Glasgow office 2 days a week.


As our Senior Casting Partner, you will sit at the very heart of Waracle’s people community, shaping how we nurture, align, and match our technical talent to rewarding client projects. Working collaboratively with leaders across Delivery and Sales, you will champion individual career growth, bring balance to project resourcing, and ensure our multidisciplinary teams thrive together in an open, supportive environment.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Collaborative Forecasting: Leading our weekly planning rhythm to align project needs with consultant availability, constructively navigating overlaps, and designing balanced solutions.

  • Bench Support & Development: Actively supporting colleagues between client engagements, balancing commercial health with individual development goals and meaningful redeployment plans.

  • Constructive Problem-Solving: Acting as a trusted, empathetic sounding board for delivery teams, facilitating thoughtful discussions to resolve resourcing trade-offs fairly.

  • Insightful Data Stewardship: Proactively auditing PSA system data, identifying trends, and ensuring reliable insight to guide inclusive talent decisions. •

  • Commercial Mindfulness: Monitoring margins and resource utilisation across practice areas, suggesting healthy adjustments that protect both project success and team well-being.

  • Strategic Team Design: Partnering on bids and proposals to shape well-rounded, future-ready team compositions and explore creative skills alternatives.

  • Workflow Improvements: Identifying opportunities to streamline resourcing routines, championing automation and practical changes to make everyday work smoother. 

  • Community Contribution: Collaborating across our wider operations team and supporting ad-hoc initiatives that support our growing community.


Research shows that underrepresented groups tend to only apply for roles that they believe they meet 100% of the criteria for. At Waracle, we want to buck that trend! We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box.

What you'll bring

  • Resourcing & Talent Background: A strong background in resourcing, workforce planning, or talent allocation/acquisition, with hands-on experience working with technical roles across software engineering, data and digital. 

  • Technical Acumen: A genuine understanding of modern digital technologies and development disciplines, paired with the intuition to match specialists with project environments where they can excel.

  • Commercial & Margin Optimisation: Commercial awareness with a focus on margin optimisation, rate structures, and balanced utilisation across consulting teams.

  • Collaborative Relationship Building: Warm, empathetic communication skills with a track record of resolving complex stakeholder trade-offs and navigating diverse perspectives. 

  • Systems & Data Fluency: Practical experience with PSA platforms, skills matrices, or applicant tracking systems, alongside an eye for spotting data patterns and maintaining accuracy. 

  • Continuous Improvement Mindset: Curiosity and initiative to identify process inefficiencies and propose automation to enhance the consultant and stakeholder experience.

What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

  • 3. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. This will be a practical presentation.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

raw.title: Senior Mobile Security Developer - Contract (Inside IR35)
raw.description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Mobile Security Developer (Inside IR35) for an exciting new 6-month initial contract joining our world-class digital technology consultancy, home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a UK-based Inside IR35 Contract role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London or Edinburgh office or on client site.


The Role

As a Senior Mobile Security Developer, you will define squad-level technical architecture and technical approach. You are a technical expert who ensures quality, security, and compliance across projects, driving robust and scalable solutions.

This role will be pivotal in building, delivering, and driving the security of our mobile platform, while being an integral part of our full-stack mobile practice, contributing to end-to-end development and security excellence across both front-end and back-end mobile systems.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Design and Delivery of a World-Class Security Framework: Lead the design and delivery of security services, including mobile penetration testing, research, consultancy, and advisory engagements.

  • Technical Strategy & Architecture: Define secure technical approaches, identify risks, and develop effective threat models and mitigation strategies.

  • Strategic Planning: Translate business objectives into technical strategy and ensure technical roadmaps align with long-term client goals.

  • Agile Practices: Expertise in Agile methodologies, with a focus on resolving impediments and driving adoption across teams.

  • Client Engagement: Communicate effectively with clients, manage expectations, and provide practical, risk-based security recommendations.

  • Continuous Improvement & Collaboration: Drive innovation, adopt emerging security practices, share knowledge, and support team success.


What you'll bring:

We are seeking a highly technical expert with a strong focus on mobile platform security. You should bring:

  • Mobile Security Expertise: Strong hands-on knowledge of Android and iOS security fundamentals, common mobile threats and vulnerabilities, security architecture, controls, and mitigation techniques.

  • Mobile Security Testing: Practical experience in mobile penetration testing, security assessments, threat modelling, and implementing or assessing security controls.

  • Security Problem Solving: A systematic and analytical approach to identifying, investigating, and resolving mobile security issues.

  • Authentication & Cryptography: Strong understanding of authentication, authorisation, cryptography, encryption, and secure design principles, with the ability to recommend appropriate cryptographic controls.

  • Continuous Improvement: A proactive approach to improving security practices, tooling, controls, and ways of working.

Desirable knowledge & experience:

  • Mobile Security Tooling & Analysis: Experience with reverse engineering, analysis techniques, and tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Frida, Objection, JADX, IDA Pro, Hopper, Radare, ADB, Apktool, YARA, Xcode, and Android Studio.

  • Mobile Development & DevSecOps: Knowledge of Android/iOS development, secure development practices, DevSecOps tooling, testing, and automation frameworks.

  • Development & Reverse Engineering: Familiarity with C, Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift, JavaScript, Python or Bash, and ideally ARM/ARM64 assembly.

  • Security Research: Awareness of emerging security technologies, Cloud security, and developments in mobile operating systems, APIs, tools, and security libraries.

What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. Depending on the role, this will be a focused take-home task (capped at 2–3 hours to respect your time) or a practical presentation.

  • 3. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

sponsor.route: Global Business Mobility: Senior or Specialist Worker

raw.title: Chief Strategic Architect
Principal, Woven Capital
raw.description:
Woven Capital is Toyota's growth-stage venture capital arm focused on advancing the future of mobility – how people, goods, information and energy move. We manage $1.6 billion, investing in companies that create new ways to support mobility and emerging technologies, advance the industrial value chain, and accelerate decarbonization and sustainability. Our work connects breakthrough innovators with Toyota's global platform, strengthening the company's capabilities today while creating new opportunities for tomorrow.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

Woven Capital is seeking an experienced Partner / Principal in London to shape the EMEA investment strategy, deepen founder and co-investor relationships, and formalize the foundation for Woven Capital’s presence in EMEA. Reporting to the CIO, the successful candidate will not only be able to lead investments end-to-end, but will also be ready and comfortable to conduct due diligence, develop trust relationships with business units on collaboration projects, and train and mentor other members of the team to develop their personal growth and career paths.


RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Source and develop investment opportunities by building and leveraging referral networks and relationships to generate high-quality deal flow. Cultivate and manage relationships with entrepreneurs, investors, academics, and industry leaders in Woven Capital’s areas of focus.
  • Lead investment due diligence by conducting market and industry research and engaging with company management, industry participants, competitors, customers, and other relevant stakeholders to assess investment opportunities.
  • Develop financial models and investment analyses, including valuations, optimal capital structures, investment terms, potential returns, and exit scenarios.
  • Structure and negotiate transactions, including drafting and reviewing term sheets, expressions of interest, and letters of intent, and negotiating deal terms and transaction documents with prospective portfolio companies, co-investors, and other relevant parties.
  • Develop investment recommendations by preparing and presenting investment memo to the Woven Capital Investment Committee for review and approval.
  • Drive portfolio value creation by actively monitoring investments, participating in board meetings as a director or observer, advising portfolio companies on strategy and growth, and facilitating strategic partnerships and business opportunities between portfolio companies and Toyota Group companies.

    • MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • 10+ years of investment experience in venture capital, corporate venture capital, or private equity, with a strong track record of sourcing, evaluating, executing, and managing investments.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, with a strong analytical foundation. A degree in finance, business, economics, engineering, science, or another relevant discipline is preferred.
  • A natural collaborator and self-starter who takes ownership, demonstrates strong leadership, and consistently drives initiatives to successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, build alignment across diverse interests, and navigate complex organizational dynamics to achieve results.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships across Toyota and its broader ecosystem, and translate those relationships into strategic opportunities and tangible business outcomes for portfolio companies.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex ideas and tailor messages and presentations to different audiences.
  • Track record of hiring, developing, and mentoring talent, as well as leading teams and managing multiple priorities in parallel.
  • Ability to navigate cultural, linguistic, and organizational differences, and move initiatives forward across global teams with different decision-making processes.

    • PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • MBA, JD, or advanced graduate degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Math or other quantitative discipline highly desired.
  • Japanese language ability is a plus but not required.
  • Experience working, studying, or living in different cultures and geographies is a plus but not required.
    • Our Commitment
    ・We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity.
    ・Any information we receive from you will be used only in the hiring and onboarding process. Please see our privacy notice for more details.

About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

We are seeking a Scientific Software Engineer to build and run the systems that connect our AI platform to physical laboratories around the world. Together with the team, you will shape the software layer of our closed-loop discovery workflow: our agents propose experiments, partner labs execute them, and the results feed back into our models to guide the next set of experiments.

This role sits between lab automation and production engineering. You will bring hands-on experience with scientific or lab automation, and the engineering discipline to make those integrations secure, reliable and scalable across many partners.

You will be part of a small team of materials scientists, ML engineers and software engineers, working closely with each other and with our partner labs. You will help define how our AI platform connects to the physical world and shape the tools and practices that link external partner labs to our platform. You will thrive here if you enjoy collaborating across disciplines and learning from people whose expertise differs from your own.

Your Impact

You will turn experimental labs into first-class, programmable parts of the CuspAI platform. Every partner you onboard, and every integration you harden, shortens the loop between an AI-generated hypothesis and a validated material.

What You Will Do

  • Help shape how we connect to partner labs around the world, accounting for different levels of automation and AI-readiness, then design, build and operate the services that send experiment requests from our AI agents and reliably bring results back.

  • Build APIs and data models (e.g. FastAPI, Pydantic) for bidirectional lab-to-cloud data exchange.

  • Integrate with lab instruments, robotic platforms, LIMS/ELN systems and scheduling software, translating between disparate formats and CuspAI's data platform.

  • Make integrations reliable at scale: idempotency, retries, queueing, monitoring and alerting across many partners and time zones.

  • Assist with the technical onboarding of new lab partners, assessing their systems and setting up integrations quickly and repeatedly.

  • Collaborate day to day with experimental materials scientists, optimisation experts and engineers on the team, co-designing workflows and feeding lab realities back into platform design.

  • Deploy and run containerised services on cloud infrastructure, with testing and CI/CD as standard.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with lab automation, self-driving labs or other scientific discovery workflows, e.g. instrument control, robotic platforms, or high-throughput experimentation data pipelines.

  • Strong software engineering background, with production experience building and operating backend services.

  • Deep fluency in Python, including typed, well-tested code and API design.

  • Experience designing distributed systems that integrate with external parties: APIs, message queues or event-driven architectures, and data contracts.

  • Solid understanding of security practices for externally facing systems.

  • A collaborative mindset: you enjoy working in a small, multidisciplinary team, and can communicate clearly with experimental scientists, optimisation experts and engineers alike.

Bonus Points

  • Experimental lab experience in materials science, chemistry or chemical engineering.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g. Dagster, Flyte, Prefect) or active learning loops.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) and observability tooling.

  • Security or compliance experience or handling partner IP and confidential data.

  • Experience working across distributed teams and multiple time zones.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is scaling fast – new enterprise customers, new products, new markets. The Billing Operations Specialist is the person who makes sure every deal that closes is reflected correctly in our systems.

This is an operational ownership role, sitting at the intersection of Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Engineering – responsible for the full billing lifecycle of our enterprise accounts, from provisioning a new customer on day one to cleanly closing out a churned account. You'll resolve discrepancies before customers notice them, catch configuration drift before it becomes a revenue problem, and build the processes that make billing feel invisible to everyone else. You'll also work on projects and programs that evolve the sophistication of our billing processes and our tooling, and help with things like pricing migrations and other critical efforts.

The ideal person is someone who is obsessive about accuracy and automation, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and energized (not frustrated) by the complexity of managing billing at scale across thousands of accounts.

Provisioning

  • Translate closed-won deals from Salesforce into correctly configured subscriptions in our billing platforms, such as Stripe – pricing plan, billing interval, contract start date, trial periods, discounts

  • Own the reconciliation between executed order forms and what's been requested for provisioning; work with Sales and Legal to resolve any gaps

  • Partner with Engineering to identify automation opportunities and build guardrails that make provisioning faster and more accurate over time

Subscription & account management

  • Process mid-cycle changes and manage renewal mechanics – upgrades, downgrades, seat changes, plan switches, and so on.

  • Handle offboarding cleanly: close subscriptions, issue final invoices or credits, ensure no residual billing

  • Resolve invoice discrepancies raised by customers or flagged by the Customer Success team – incorrect amounts, missing credits, misapplied discounts

Revenue integrity

  • Run periodic audits of active subscriptions to verify billing matches contracted terms

  • Identify and remediate ghost subscriptions, duplicate customers, and orphaned invoices

  • Support month-end and quarter-end close by reconciling billing platforms with Finance's records

  • Surface pricing or configuration anomalies to relevant teams.

Requirements

Must-have

  • 2-5 years in billing operations, revenue operations, finance operations or a similar role supporting B2B or enterprise customers (adjust the range for level)

  • Hands-on experience with a subscription billing platform, ideally Stripe Billing or similar (Chargebee, Zuora, Recurly), including subscriptions, invoices, credits, coupons and billing intervals

  • Experience turning closed-won deals and order forms into correct billing configurations (pricing plan, start date, trial, discounts)

  • Strong attention to detail and a record of catching discrepancies before customers do

  • Can read a contract or order form and spot gaps against what was requested for provisioning

  • Experience reconciling billing data to finance records, including supporting month-end or quarter-end close

  • Comfort working with Salesforce (or another CRM) as the source of truth for deals

  • Clear written communication and ability to work across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal and Engineering

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and with managing a high volume of accounts without losing track

Strong plus

  • Experience with usage-based or hybrid pricing

  • Familiarity with SQL, spreadsheets at scale (pivots, lookups), or BI tools, for audits and reconciliation

  • Experience building automation or scripts, or partnering with Engineering on guardrails (APIs, webhooks, no-code tools)

  • Experience running subscription audits, such as finding ghost subscriptions, duplicate customers and orphaned invoices

  • Experience with pricing migrations or billing-system migrations

  • Exposure to ASC 606 or revenue recognition basics

  • Experience with a quote-to-cash stack (CPQ, contract management, ERP such as NetSuite)

  • Experience at a high-growth SaaS or AI company

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States or Europe.

We're the fastest-growing startup transforming the IP industry.

  • Traction: 20-30% MoM revenue growth; selling to 700+ global IP teams (DLA Piper, tech boutiques, and global enterprises).

  • Proven Value: Users report 50-90% efficiency gains using our AI platform.

  • Backing: Recently featured in Sifted following our $40M Series B announcement, bringing our total funding to $55M from elite investors including Y Combinator, 20VC, Visionaries, Microsoft and Thomson Reuters.

🏗️ About the role

We’re hiring a data engineer to build the ingestion and search systems behind Solve Intelligence’s AI products.

Our sources include global patent literature, case law, technical standards and contributions, scientific databases, academic papers, and content from across the web. The data spans structured records, documents, images, audio and video. You’ll work across bulk ingestion and on-demand retrieval, making this information searchable and useful in our products

You’ll own systems from source acquisition through to serving queries. The work includes:

  • Large-scale ingestion. Build and operate high-throughput, resumable pipelines for large datasets, with efficient incremental updates, monitoring and recovery from failures.

  • Document processing and data quality. Extract useful content from complex documents and other formats. Handle malformed records and changing schemas, and validate outputs while preserving structure and metadata.

  • Search and serving. Build keyword, vector and structured search, and design schemas, indexes and partitioning for fast queries over tens to hundreds of millions of records.

  • Connecting information across sources. Link patents, scientific records and supporting documents, preserve dates and versions, and make results traceable to their original sources.

  • Performance engineering. Profile parsing, ingestion, database builds and queries throughout development, testing against representative datasets at realistic scale. Diagnose CPU, memory and storage I/O bottlenecks, and tune jobs and infrastructure for throughput, latency and cost.

You’ll work closely with our AI researchers and product engineers, with substantial freedom to choose the approach and build the systems yourself.

🛠️ What you bring

Must haves:

  • Strong Python and SQL, with experience designing and operating production databases.

  • Solid experience building and operating production data pipelines over large, messy datasets.

  • Expertise with running search systems over large document collections.

  • End-to-end ownership from raw data to user-facing functionality.

  • A good understanding of schema design, indexing and query optimisation.

  • A track record of diagnosing and fixing performance bottlenecks in live systems through profiling and measurement.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with PostgreSQL/pgvector, OpenSearch (or Elasticsearch), Spark/Delta Lake, AWS, NoSQL databases, or Rust/C++ is useful.

👋 The Founders

You'll partner with a founding team of AI PhDs and elite systems engineers:

  • Sanj (CRO): PhD in AI (Gatsby Unit, UCL), ex-Huawei R&D, former lead at Magic Carpet AI (acquired).

  • Chris (CEO): PhD in AI (UCL), published researcher, ex-Dyson and Alan Turing Institute.

  • Angus (CTO): MEng Computer Science, ex-Qualcomm and Coremont (Brevan Howard).

What we offer

  • Competitive Salary + Significant Equity: We want you to have true ownership in the success of the company.

  • Founding Impact: You'll have a direct hand in how we build out the data infrastructure the rest of the product depends on.

  • Support: Full visa sponsorship and private medical insurance.

  • The Environment: Free meals and a seat at the table with an incredibly smart, ambitious team.

raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

As part of Checkout.com’s #NextGen Early Careers Program, we are looking for an ambitious Finance Analyst Apprentice to join our fast-paced EU Finance department. Reporting directly to the Regional Finance Director, you will work alongside experienced professionals, gain hands-on experience, and join a global community with technical training, mentorship, and regular networking opportunities to accelerate your growth.

Through a structured three-year program, you will balance real team deliverables with study towards your ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants) qualification, dedicating 20% of your time (around six hours per week) to your professional studies. Each placement will be supported by a dedicated Rotation Manager alongside guidance from senior Finance leadership.

You will gain broad exposure across six core finance pillars: Financial Control and Revenue & Billing in year one; Tax and Treasury in year two; and Strategic Finance and Finance Transformation in year three. Depending on business and ACCA requirements, you may also gain exposure to adjacent areas such as Product Control, Procurement, or Internal Audit.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Support accurate, timely finance operations across your rotations, contributing to processes such as month-end close, reconciliations, journals and variance analysis.

  • Help teams deliver invoicing, settlement, revenue recognition, tax compliance, cash management, budgeting and reporting activities.

  • Prepare and review information carefully, including supporting audit, compliance and management reporting requirements.

  • Work with colleagues across Finance to respond to queries, share information and deliver tasks to agreed deadlines.

  • Look for practical ways to improve processes, documentation and the use of finance systems and data.

  • Apply what you learn through ACCA study to real finance work, building technical, analytical and communication skills over time.

Eligibility Requirements

This role is offered as a government-funded Level 7 ACCA apprenticeship. Appointment is conditional on the successful candidate meeting the government’s apprenticeship funding and eligibility requirements at the start of training, as confirmed by our approved training provider. Under current England funding rules, Level 7 funding is generally available to applicants aged 16–21, with limited exceptions for eligible applicants aged 22–24 who have an EHCP or have been, or are, in care.

This role is offered as an early-careers opportunity and we are not able to offer this role on a privately funded basis. Further information about the Apprenticeship funding can be found here.

  • Academic Qualifications: You will have either:

  • A degree qualification

    OR

  • You have completed a Level 4 AAT qualification before the September start date

+ 2 A Levels (or equivalent) and 3 GCSEs including a pass in English and Maths

Visa sponsorship: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

What We’re Looking For

  • Academic Ambition: You are eager to begin your journey toward becoming a Chartered Accountant via the ACCA pathway.

  • Analytical Mindset: You have a natural comfort with numbers and a high attention to detail.

  • Resilience: The ability to work toward tight deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth work environment.

  • Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets. Any prior exposure to accounting systems (like Workday) is a huge plus, but not a dealbreaker—we will train you!

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a "team player" attitude.

  • Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets; familiarity with finance systems such as Workday is helpful, but not essential.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

You will contribute across areas such as identity and access, end-user devices, collaboration and productivity platforms, IT assets and licences, and office technology.   • Identity and Access: Support secure identity lifecycle and access management, including joiner, mover, and leaver activities, single sign-on, group and role administration, and least-privilege access.

  • End-User Technology: Help manage and support company endpoints and workplace services. Apply approved configurations and security controls, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to a consistent employee experience across platforms.

  • Platform Administration: Configure and maintain team-managed applications and services. Learn unfamiliar platforms quickly, follow established governance, and identify when a change needs specialist or security review.

  • Operational Excellence: Provide dependable operational support, maintain clear documentation and runbooks, and help the team improve service quality, reliability, and supportability.

  • Incident and Change Management: Own incidents through the full lifecycle, from triage, prioritisation, and stakeholder communication through safe service restoration, root-cause analysis, and follow-up actions. Maintain accurate incident records, capture decisions and remediation, and document recurring issues and operational procedures in clear, current runbooks and knowledge articles. Plan and implement changes safely, with appropriate testing, approvals, and rollback plans.

  • Project Delivery: Plan and deliver small-to-medium technical projects, coordinating with stakeholders and other teams to manage dependencies, risks, and outcomes.

  • Automation and Improvement: Identify repeatable manual work and service friction. Propose or build appropriately controlled automation and simpler workflows to reduce toil and improve consistency.

  • Asset and Licence Management: Support accurate technology inventory, licence administration, and lifecycle processes, helping the team make effective and responsible use of its tools and equipment.

  • Knowledge Sharing: Share learning across the team, contribute to onboarding and operational guidance, and support colleagues as they develop their technical skills.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Typically 2-3+ years in IT engineering, workplace technology, systems administration, or a similar technical role.

  • Technical Breadth: Practical experience supporting or administering a range of workplace technology services. You have a strong foundation in at least one relevant area and are motivated to build capability across others.

  • Communication: Work effectively with colleagues, stakeholders, and technical teams. Translate technical detail into clear updates and provide helpful, user-focused support.

  • Adaptability: Comfortable working across a varied technology estate, learning new tools, and balancing planned delivery with operational priorities in a changing environment.

  • Teamwork: Share knowledge, ask for help when needed, and contribute positively to a team that works across multiple technical domains.

raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role Purpose

The Manager, Procurement Operations & Transformation will be the functional owner responsible for both the strategic evolution and the daily operational execution of Checkout.com’s Procurement and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) functions.

The role is structured across four core pillars:

  • Transformation: Setting the long-term vision, target operating model, and multi-year transformation initiatives, roadmaps, business cases, and cost-benefit analyses across all operating model components: Service Delivery Model, People, Process, Reporting & Data, Governance & Controls, and Automation/AI.

  • Operations: Managing the day-to-day Procurement Operations team, monitoring functional health, data quality, and operational metrics, as well as eliminating bottlenecks and escalations across sourcing and corporate travel.

  • Business Partnering: Acting as the primary strategic bridge between Procurement and core business functions (Technology, InfoSec, Risk, Legal, and People) to ensure cross-functional alignment and service delivery.

  • Program Management & Governance: Leading programmatic execution, centralizing compliance and regulatory inputs, servicing audit requirements, and managing functional roadmaps with support teams.

The primary objective is to modernize Procurement and TPRM into high-performing service functions delivering superior customer experience, strict SLAs, advanced automation, and scalable tooling architectures.

Key Responsibilities

1. Transformation & Operating Model Strategy

  • Define and execute the global strategy, target operating model, and vision across all Procurement & TPRM components: Service Delivery Model, Process, People, Reporting & Data, Governance & Controls, and Automation/AI.

  • Map strategy into prioritized roadmaps supported by concrete business cases and cost-benefit analyses.

  • Define the functional AI and automation strategy, sponsoring the delivery of automated capabilities in partnership with Technology to maximize throughput and operational efficiency.

  • Establish and monitor core operational metrics, KPIs, and SLAs to track function health, service quality, and risk posture.

  • Partner with Accounts Payable to drive end-to-end Source-to-Pay process optimization and touchless execution.

2. Operational Leadership & Escalation Management

  • Lead and manage the Procurement Operations team, ensuring category management teams receive required data, analytics, and operational support.

  • Own vendor master data governance to maintain maximum accuracy and integrity across downstream systems and reporting.

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for operational blockers across Procurement, corporate travel, and P2P handoffs.

  • Maintain functional relationships with platform providers and monitor tooling health, releases, and integrations in collaboration with Technology.

3. Tooling Ecosystem Ownership

  • Zip: Act as joint business owner with Accounts Payable, functionally managing intake-to-contract workflows, vendor onboarding, and P2P handoffs.

  • OneTrust: Functionally own TPRM risk assessment workflows and vendor risk oversight.

raw.title: SAR Manager
raw.description:
Trust unlocks our greatest potential.

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’.

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Financial Crime Intelligence & Investigations Team as a Financial Crime SAR Manager? Reporting to the Senior Manager, you’ll act as a subject matter expert for financial crime intelligence analysis across our client base. Including conducting analysis of potential suspicious activity across a range of financial crime escalations, producing reports for both internal and external audiences, and providing support across the wider team where needed.

Candidates need to have proven experience in financial crime intelligence across different payment platforms and services. You’ll also have an excellent understanding of financial crime typologies, detection methods and intelligence analysis techniques, and share this knowledge with other members of the team. You’ll be comfortable working in an energetic environment and dealing with change whilst taking pride in owning and mitigating financial crime risk for the business.

You’ll demonstrate the confidence to raise concerns, shape strategic thinking and make well-informed decisions. You’ll bring strong knowledge of payment services, together with extensive technical and regulatory expertise across financial crime and sanctions in the UK and other jurisdictions, including relevant reporting obligations. You’ll also have a proven ability to identify, assess, and mitigate financial crime risk across the business.

Your role includes:

  • Leading complex financial crime investigations and providing senior-level oversight, challenge and direction on material or high-risk cases

  • Overseeing the allocation and prioritisation of investigative activity, ensuring resources are effectively deployed and key regulatory and operational deadlines are met

  • Building and managing effective relationships with senior stakeholders across the business, providing clear advice, challenge and escalation on financial crime matters

  • Providing oversight of financial crime risks associated with existing and emerging products and services, ensuring appropriate mitigation strategies are developed and implemented

  • Driving the development of financial crime, sanctions and money laundering typology knowledge across the team and wider business

  • Overseeing complex end-to-end enquiries and ensuring appropriate, timely and risk-based outcomes

  • Directing and overseeing research and intelligence activity to support the identification, assessment and investigation of potentially suspicious activity

  • Providing oversight and approval of relevant regulatory reports and disclosures, ensuring compliance with applicable AML legislation, regulation and reporting obligations

  • Accountable for team outcomes and responsible for complex/high risk decision making

  • Applying extensive technical and regulatory expertise to identify control weaknesses, assess risk exposure and influence appropriate remediation

  • Acting as a senior subject matter expert on financial crime and maintaining awareness of emerging AML trends, typologies and industry developments to strengthen the Bank’s detection and control capabilities

  • Developing strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders to influence decision-making, support strategic objectives and deliver effective financial crime risk management

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Extensive experience leading and providing oversight of complex financial crime investigations

  • Strong knowledge and practical application of financial crime control frameworks, regulatory requirements and industry standards

  • Good knowledge of sectors such as money remittance, electronic money, and cryptocurrency firms would be beneficial

  • Understanding of UK and EU AML/CTF legislation (international AML/CTF knowledge is advantageous)

  • Meticulous organisational skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate and negotiate with key/senior stakeholders

  • Understanding of money laundering typologies across a range of products and services

  • Solutions driven, with the appetite for constant improvement

  • In-depth knowledge of AML regulations and guidelines

  • Strong ethical standards and integrity in handling sensitive information

  • A recognised AML/Sanctions/Fraud qualification is highly desirable

  • Previous experience of Delegated Nominated Officer responsibilities would be advantageous

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;

  • You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care;

  • You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate;

  • ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

Who We’re Looking For
We are looking for a Solutions Consultant to support the development of the European region by providing technical expertise and experience to the team, customers, and partners.
In this role, you will actively drive and manage the technology evaluation stage of the sales process, working in conjunction with the sales team as the key technical adviser and product advocate. You will also rapidly identify all technical issues of assigned accounts to assure complete customer satisfaction through all stages of the sales process.

Responsibilities
Customer Oriented:
  • Conduct key customer meetings with Sales Executives, offering technical expertise and support on the product roadmap.
  • Define vision and strategy for CRM and BPM opportunities, designing/configuring custom demos, presentations, training, and supportive materials.
  • Deliver product demonstrations to key accounts, tailored to match customer expectations and needs.
  • Assist in the production of RFPs and other proposals to clients.
  • Design and deliver high-quality technical Proof of Concepts for prospective customers.
  • Represent products to customers and at field events such as conferences, summits, seminars, etc.
    • Partner Oriented:
  • Communicate the company vision to key prospect partners, aiding in their understanding of our product roadmap.
  • Assist partners in defining sales strategies based on product specifics and capabilities.
    • Company and Team-Oriented:
  • Perform competitor analysis and provide feedback to R&D and Product teams, contributing to product development and Sales Enablement.
  • Participate in defining deal-win strategies and region development strategies.
  • Present technical and business aspects of proposed solutions to a C-Level audience.

    • Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Solutions Consultant (Presales) in the SaaS/ PaaS industry, with a proven track record of success in handling complex sales deals that involve scenarios such as custom POCs and demos.
  • Experience with CRM / BPM / ERP / HCM systems, or No-Code/Low-Code Platforms.
  • Technical depth to respond to all functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.
  • Demonstrated experience working closely with C-level managers on the client side, understanding their needs, and providing tailored solutions.
  • In-depth knowledge of the European market dynamics, including industry trends, competitor landscape, and regulatory environment.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and convincingly.
  • Proven success in conveying customer requirements to Product Management teams.
  • Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving skills, with the ability to think out of the box, identify opportunities and drive results.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients and attend industry events.
  • Fluent English.
  • Recent hands-on experience with programming within modern web or enterprise development systems.
  • Familiarity with production environments (application servers, web servers, databases).

raw.title: Director, Customer Success
raw.description:
Director, Customer Success (EMEA)

As our EMEA Customer Success organization continues to evolve, we're looking for a strategic and commercially minded Customer Success leader to help shape the next phase of growth for our customers, team, and business.

As Director, Customer Success, you'll lead a team of Customer Success Professionals while helping some of the world's leading brands maximize the value of CreatorIQ. You'll bring a combination of Customer Success leadership, enterprise commercial expertise, and creator marketing knowledge to drive retention, growth, and long-term partnership success across EMEA. As a member of the EMEA Customer Success leadership team, you'll own portfolio performance, forecasting, strategic customer engagement, team development, and operational excellence while helping shape the future of Customer Success at CreatorIQ.

Location: London, UK (Hybrid, 3 days per week in office)

Travel: Approximately 20% travel across EMEA customer locations.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Success Professionals while fostering a culture of accountability, performance, and customer-centricity.

  • Own portfolio performance across EMEA, driving customer retention, growth, forecasting accuracy, risk mitigation, and long-term customer success.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders and help enterprise brands maximize the impact and maturity of their creator marketing programs.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Professional Services, and Support to advocate for customer needs and influence strategic business outcomes.

  • Apply industry knowledge and market insights to help customers evolve their creator marketing strategies and achieve measurable business outcomes.

  • Serve as a senior leader within the EMEA organization, driving escalations, operational priorities, organizational development, and cross-functional initiatives.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • 8+ years of experience leading Enterprise Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, or related customer-facing teams within SaaS, MarTech, AdTech, Social Media Technology, or Creator Marketing organizations.

  • Proven experience leading Enterprise Customer Success or Strategic Account teams with responsibility for retention, renewals, expansion, customer growth, and portfolio performance.

  • Demonstrated success developing and leading high-performing Customer Success Professionals and Managers while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Strong executive presence with experience advising senior stakeholders, including CMOs, Heads of Influencer Marketing, Heads of Social, VPs, and other senior business leaders.

  • Strong commercial acumen with ownership of retention, revenue growth, forecasting, and strategic customer outcomes.

  • Experience managing strategic enterprise customer relationships, executive business reviews, complex escalations, and high-impact customer risk situations.

  • Ability to independently lead cross-functional initiatives and influence outcomes across Sales, Product, Marketing, Professional Services, and Support teams.

  • Direct experience within influencer marketing, creator economy, creator technology, social media technology, MarTech, or a closely related industry strongly preferred. Candidates from creator marketing platforms, social/creator agencies, or brand-side creator marketing organizations are especially encouraged to apply.

  • Demonstrated understanding of creator marketing trends, influencer strategy, measurement frameworks, and the evolving creator economy landscape.

  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, customer insights, forecasting, operational efficiency, and customer engagement.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Interested about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply!

What you will get from us:

  • People: work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you’ll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Work/life harmony: 25 days vacation, floating and set holidays, wellness allowance, and paid parental leave.

  • Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Healthcare coverage, encompassing mental health, physical therapies, dental, vision, cancer coverage, and more.

  • Comprehensive perks program providing stipends for wellness, cell phone and internet, home office setup, mental wellness, professional development, plus occasional company-funded meal opportunities throughout the year.

Compensation, Benefits and Beyond:

We know that benefits play a significant role in your overall compensation. We invite you to review our benefits and perks.

Who we are:

CreatorIQ is enterprise infrastructure for creator marketing, trusted by more than 1,300 of the world's leading brands and agencies, including Beiersdorf, Delta Air Lines, Dentsu, Google, Nestlé, and Wella. Powered by the Creator Graph®, CreatorIQ's proprietary AI and intelligence foundation grounded in over 11 years of data, it’s built for teams, agents, and the entire enterprise tech stack. With headquarters in Los Angeles and offices in Austin, London, Manila, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw, CreatorIQ’s global team moves quickly and deliberately because we're setting the pace for an industry that's still being defined.

Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

At CreatorIQ, different perspectives make our work better. The people we hire come from different backgrounds and think in different ways — and that's exactly what helps us connect with each other, and with the customers and creators we serve.We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, and being a good human, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

AI Transparency Notice

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and note taking during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

raw.title: Senior Agent Product Manager
raw.description:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

About the Team

When a Fortune 500 C-suite brings in Decagon, they are not buying a support tool. They are buying a transformation of how their customers experience their brand, end to end. Agent Product Managers are the people they trust to make that transformation real.

Your counterpart is the C-suite, and what they are asking you to transform is their entire customer experience. You define the roadmap, the frameworks, and the decision-making models that make a top-down transformation feel safe to bet on. You hold that relationship from the first pre-sales conversation through the life of the account.

The work compounds in a way most roles don't. Every flagship deployment you lead feeds directly into our playbooks and raises the quality of every build that follows. Hard-won lessons on your accounts become leverage across the whole company, and the IP you create outlives any single agent.

These are the largest, most complex enterprises in the market. The ones that require deep customization, real judgment, and a partner who can operate at the highest level. This is not a standardized implementation role, and it is not an account management or customer success role.

 

About the Role

This role owns the successful delivery, adoption, and expansion of AI solutions for Decagon's customers, serving as the primary technical and strategic owner. You earn trust with the customer's leadership team, scope a solution that solves their problems, and then build the working AI agent. You are the direct owner for each account's agents end-to-end, partnering with our Strategic Account Directors, Agent Strategy Managers and Forward Deployed Engineers to scale the agent in production and grow it into a core part of how the customer's company runs.

It is a rare combination: the executive influence of a top strategy consulting leader, the instincts of a product builder, and the ownership of a founder. If you have ever wanted to build the solution instead of hand off the recommendation, this role was designed for you. You own the outcome end to end, on the highest-stakes accounts in the market, with all of Decagon's cross-functional teams behind you.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You are trusted to make high-stakes decisions independently and own outcomes, gaining leverage by directing forward deployed engineers and partner teams who own a share of the execution.

 

In this role, you will

  • Own the technical win on Decagon's largest strategic opportunities, partnering with Sales, Solutions Engineers and Forward-deployed engineers to build working AI agents that turn sophisticated, skeptical buyers into signed customers.

  • Serve as the executive partner to the C-suite of Fortune 500 companies, defining and driving their AI transformation roadmap and owning the relationship from first conversation through production and expansion.

  • Design, build, and optimize enterprise-grade AI agents in production, going deep on each customer's workflows, pain points, and goals.

  • Turn the frameworks and playbooks you develop into reusable assets that scale across accounts and feed directly into Decagon's product roadmap.

  • Direct Forward-deployed engineers and partner teams to deliver at scale while you stay accountable for the outcome.

  • Run tight feedback loops into Product and Engineering, shaping the product based on what you learn on the front lines of our most demanding deployments.

     

Your background looks something like this

  • 6+ years of experience owning ambiguous, high-stakes outcomes and earning the trust of senior executives. This includes engagement managers, project leaders, and senior managers from top consulting firms, as well as product managers, founders, and forward-deployed or solutions roles at high-growth technology companies.

  • A builder's instinct. You want to design and build the actual solution, not just diagnose the problem or manage someone else who builds it.

  • Strong technical acumen. You can understand and shape AI agent designs and hold your own in a technical conversation with both engineers and executives.

  • Executive presence and a track record of becoming a trusted advisor to senior decision-makers at large, complex organizations.

  • Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you shape the solution as much as you implement it.

     

Even better

  • A Computer Science, Engineering, or Math degree, or equivalent hands-on technical experience.

  • An MBA, or equivalent experience at the intersection of business strategy and technology, is a plus.

  • Experience selling, deploying, or advising on enterprise software or transformation programs at the Fortune 500 level.

Compensation

£145k – £180K + Offers Equity

Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

  • Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

  • Parental Leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

  • Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

  • Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.

Compensation: £145K – £180K • Offers Equity
